sod_rules.rationale: A user who can create a vendor and approve payments to it can route funds to an entity they control.
Self-approval of purchase orders removes the second pair of eyes the control exists to provide.
Creating an invoice and posting the corresponding journal entry allows a fictitious transaction to be recorded without review.
Confirming receipt of goods you also approved weakens the three-way match.
A user who can change their own permissions can grant themselves approval rights.
